requirement_vague: Verify following a user updates the profile following status correctly and prevents self-following

omissions.description: POST /api/profiles/{username}/follow does not return the required 201 status when following another user.
omissions.reasoning: The route @app.post("/api/profiles/{username}/follow") has no status_code specified, so FastAPI returns 200 by default. The requirement expects status 201 for following user2.

omissions.description: Self-following is not prevented with a 400 error and message containing 'cannot be equal'.
omissions.reasoning: In follow_user, when current_user.id == target.id, the code simply skips creating the FollowLink and returns the profile response successfully. There is no rejection, no 400 status, and no error message mentioning 'cannot be equal'.
